name: bubble
title: Bubble
description: One message as a control-weight frame (2px, no radius) holding cells: the text, then files (Attachment layout="cell"). Consecutive bubbles attach on a 1px seam. Tone by role: plain (theirs), tint (yours), attention (not sent: the attention frame and an inserted ! cell). pending runs the Signal segment on the bottom keyline while it sends. Reactions sit on the bottom keyline.
whenToUse: Use it for one chat message with its files and reactions. To group a sender's consecutive messages use Message; for the scrolling log use Message scroller.

props.name: pending
props.description: Sending: the pending segment runs along the bottom keyline (a static hatch under reduced motion).

parts.name: BubbleContent
parts.description: The text cell. Render it as a button or link (`render`) when the message itself acts (open a thread).

parts.name: BubbleGroup
parts.description: A column of bubbles outside a Message (a Message's content is already one).

parts.name: BubbleReactions
parts.description: Reactions on the bubble's bottom keyline: a row of small cells ("👍 2"). Buttons inside are fine.
